plugins.name: agent-config
plugins.description: The Agent Config Standard (ACS v1) as a reusable skill: layered global/repo/local settings, credential references that keep secrets out of git, and a re-runnable onboarding flow. Other skills and subagents invoke it instead of restating the rules, and vendor its zero-dependency loader instead of copying their own.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Run a multi-part task as small, tracked, parallel work packages — one agent, one output file each — with an async question protocol so waiting on human decisions never blocks progress.

plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Run and manage AI subagents in herdr panes from named presets stored in agent config - start, ask, read, converse, list, stop - and drive the herdr terminal workspace manager: workspaces, worktrees, tabs, panes, and "which one am I in".

plugins.name: ml-slop
plugins.description: Find and score AI-generation slop. text measures information density and semantic repetition in prose, and can rewrite to remove it; code scores a git diff or standalone files for duplication, dead code, redundant comments, verbosity, over-abstraction, error masking, convention violations, hallucinated dependencies, and performance waste.

plugins.name: ml-workplace
plugins.description: The tools a team works in, driven from Claude Code through bundled zero-dependency bun CLIs, no MCP server. atlassian: Jira and Confluence over REST — JQL search, create, comment, and transition issues, sprints and boards, read and write Confluence pages, Cloud and Data Center. fellow: read-only Fellow meeting notes, transcripts, AI summaries, and action items, with recaps filed into a repo.

plugins.name: code-comment-guidelines
plugins.description: Explicit-only code comment guidelines for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. Comments are reserved for non-obvious constraints, invariants, workarounds, or surprising behavior.
